correctness.rationale: The base relative bar kernel is computed explicitly as \(Ae_2\otimes e_3A\oplus Ae_3\otimes e_2A\), hence is ordinary \(A^e\)-projective. The source's published base value \(\operatorname{gldim}(A,B)=1\) then forces \(\operatorname{pd}_{(A^e,B^e)}A=1\). Theorem 4.9 gives the tensor-power lower bound, Corollary 4.10 gives the equal upper bound, and the tensor-radical formula proves the ideal condition. The bundled exact checker reconstructs and verifies the base balanced tensor calculation.

originality.rationale: Remark 5.6 of arXiv:2609.31642v1 explicitly asks whether every positive integer can be realized as the gap under \(AJ(B)\triangleleft A\). The paper realizes arbitrary positive gaps without that condition and proves tensor additivity only in a different homologically controllable class. No inspected source states the tensor-power family or the base regular-bimodule computation.
residual_risks: The motivating preprint is very recent, so a contemporaneous independent observation may not yet be indexed.

Only the directly relevant portions of the 2023 dissertation were inspected through searchable text; an equivalent regular-bimodule calculation under different notation remains a bounded residual risk.

value.rationale: Remark 5.6 poses the ideal-constrained positive-gap realization as an explicit open problem.
